summary: E2E testing of Dijital Roket batch-2 features: Editor enhancements (tags chips + SEO + image-size buttons), Brand Management CRUD, Brand portal auth + generate flow, credit gating, token isolation. 15/15 backend pytest cases PASS. Frontend: brand login → /firma/panel works, credits badge 3/3 shows correctly, generate triggers POST /api/brand/generate which returns 502 (expected — OpenAI billing limit), UI shows 'Görsel üretilemedi' toast, button re-enables, credit NOT deducted (0→0 confirmed via re-fetched /api/brand/me). Admin /Markalar (AI)/ tab renders brands table with email + visible plain password + credits used/total + logo position + action icons; 'Yeni Marka' modal has 9-cell logo position grid (logo-pos-* x9), brand-save-btn, color picker, portal credentials, logo upload. Token isolation verified: admin token gets 401 on /api/brand/me, brand token gets 401 on /api/admin/brands.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1043 lines — recommend splitting into routers/ (admin, brand, public), models.py, auth.py, seed.py, services/ai.py for maintainability.

Brand portal passwords stored as plain text in MongoDB (by design per PRD — admin-visible). Acceptable for this MVP but flag as security trade-off; consider symmetric encryption at rest using a server-side key so DB dumps don't expose passwords.

dr_generate_image: when OPENAI billing is restored, the model name 'gpt-image-2' must be confirmed against the live OpenAI catalog — current code surfaces 502 generically without distinguishing model-not-found vs billing.
Credit deduction is correctly placed AFTER successful image generation (verified by code review and live 502 test — credits_used unchanged). Good.
Caption generation uses gpt-4o which is gated by the same OpenAI key — likely also blocked when billing limit hit; UI gracefully shows empty caption (try/except returns ''). OK.
_ensure_credit_period correctly auto-resets credits_used at month rollover; verified via code review.
Brand token type='brand' separation enforced in get_current_brand — token isolation works in both directions (verified by tests).

TagInput / ContentEditor / BrandForm / LogoPositionPicker / BrandUsage components are colocated in AdminDashboard.jsx — if that file is >800 lines, consider extracting them into /components/admin/ for reusability and to keep the dashboard file lean.
Brand /firma/panel uses brandApi axios instance with token from localStorage 'dr_brand_token'; admin uses 'dr_token' — clean separation, no collision.
seed_data_creation: Tests create+delete TEST_ prefixed brands (zero-credit + create/update/delete). No persistent test data left behind. testmarka brand untouched (still 3 credits used=0).
context_for_next_testing_agent: New batch-2 backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_brand_and_editor.py (15 cases). Brand portal end-to-end at /firma/giris → /firma/panel works; generate flow gracefully handles OpenAI 502 (billing hard limit) without leaking credits. When OpenAI billing is restored, the same test will pass on 200 path automatically (test asserts either 200 with +1 used OR 502 with 0 delta). Frontend testids confirmed: brand-credits, brand-prompt-input, brand-format-post/story, brand-generate-btn, brand-no-credit, brand-new-btn, brand-save-btn, logo-pos-* (x9), brand-usage-* (history icon per row), brand-login-form/email/password/submit, blog-tags-input, blog-seo-title, blog-seo-description, content-img-size-100/75/50. Admin login submit button is NOT type='submit' — use get_by_role('button', name='Giriş Yap') or click by data-testid if added later.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. The expected 502 on /api/brand/generate is a known OpenAI billing_hard_limit_reached condition (confirmed in backend logs and per problem statement) — server.py correctly raises HTTPException(502, 'Görsel üretilemedi…') BEFORE incrementing credits_used; both backend test and live UI test confirm credit is NOT deducted on failure.
